WHAT IS LIVECV?

Meet your
Digital Career Identity.

Your GID (Global ID) is one permanent link, like livecv.work/id/GID-12345-67890, that always shows the latest version of you: experience, projects, skills, education and goals.

Under it, you publish tailored CVIDs: a version of your resume for each role you apply to, each with its own short link.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Know what happens next.

Can I start for free?

Yes. Build your ATS-friendly resume and export it as a PDF for free, with no account needed to start. Live links, analytics and AI tools are on paid plans.

See plans →
What is a GID?

Your Global ID is your permanent professional identity on LiveCV: one stable, lifetime link, like livecv.work/id/GID-12345-67890, that always points to the most current version of you. You get one GID, and it never expires.

What’s a CVID?

A CVID is a tailored version of your resume, such as one for design roles or one for a specific company, with its own short link. Your CVIDs sit under your GID, and when you update one, everyone holding that link sees the latest version.

How is this different from sending a PDF?

A PDF is a frozen snapshot that starts going stale the moment you send it. Your LiveCV link is live: update once and every recruiter who opens it sees the latest version. You can still export a PDF whenever an application asks for one.

Can I see who viewed my resume?

Yes, on paid plans. You’ll see how many times each CVID was opened, from which locations, on which devices and when, so you can follow up at the right moment.

What does ATS-compliant mean?

Most companies screen resumes with an Applicant Tracking System before a person reads them. LiveCV creates clean, structured resumes that these systems can read, without the graphics or columns that confuse them.
